channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Paper Bunny Press Opens New Ravenswood Stationery Shop
item.description: The cozy storefront’s shelves include greeting cards, stickers, notepads, sticky pads, planners, calendars, magnets and more designed or curated by owner Samantha Rekas.

item.title: City Animal Shelter Needs New Chief Amid ‘Concerning’ Conditions, Alderpeople And Volunteers Say
item.description: After Animal Care and Control went without a permanent executive director for three years, Mayor Brandon Johnson appointed its acting chief to the position. Activists and officials want a broader search to address persistent problems at the shelter.

item.title: Pritzker’s Budget Plan Calls For Education Funding Increases But Falls Short Of Requests
item.description: The proposal is the opening of budget negotiations. State lawmakers are expected to finalize a budget in May.

item.title: Chicago Man Jumps Into Lake To Save Baby After Stroller Blows Into Water: ‘I Guess I’m Going In’
item.description: Lio Cundiff — who can't swim — was out for a walk when strong winds blew a stroller with a baby inside into the lake Wednesday. He jumped in, holding the stroller above water until bystanders helped pull them to safety near Belmont Harbor.

item.title: Whiner Beer Company Closing Back Of The Yards Brewery, Taproom: ‘We Gave It Our Best Shot’
item.description: The Le Tub saison-makers announced Friday that they will close March 29 after a decade in Back of the Yards. It's the third Chicago brewery to announce a closure so far this year as the industry struggles.

item.title: Northwest Side’s Illuminated Brew Works To Close In June: ‘We Will Miss All Of You’
item.description: Illuminated is the second brewery to close this year on the Northwest Side, and the third to announce a closure in the first weeks of 2026.

item.title: Chicago Dance Crew Honors Members Killed In Crash: ‘They Will Forever Be In Our Hearts’
item.description: Lazarus "Hollywood" Gonzalez and Isaiah "Bo" Flemister died in a car crash Thursday. Flemister was one of the best footwork dancers in Chicago, and Gonzalez "changed the narrative" for majorette dancing, their coach said.

item.title: Teens Charged With Killing 2 Men In Lakeview, Bronzeville During Carjacking Spree
item.description: Two teenagers are accused of fatally shooting Darwin Tirado, 22, during a carjacking in Lakeview before killing Damon Kellum, 45, during an attempted carjacking in Bronzeville an hour apart on Feb. 11, authorities said.

item.title: 2 Girls, 6 and 15, Seriously Injured In Englewood Hit-And-Run As Police Search For Driver
item.description: Police released a photo of the SUV suspected in the hit-and-run, which critically injured a 6-year-old girl and left a 15-year-old girl with serious abrasion injuries.

item.title: 29 People Displaced In Logan Square Apartment Fires Over Weekend, Including 12 Children
item.description: 12 adults and 10 children were displaced in an apartment fire in the 2200 block of N. Hamlin Ave. Saturday night. On Sunday afternoon, a house fire in the 1900 block of N. Ridgeway Ave. left another seven adults displaced. No serious injuries were reported.
